reflections.summary: Lost because preview plan brought two physical attackers (Kingambit + Dragonite) into Talonflame Will-O-Wisp + Fairy Aura Floette-Mega + Rough Skin Garchomp. Burn on Kingambit on T5 removed win condition, Dragonite could not trade with Garchomp, and Gengar-Mega provided no pressure vs Floette/Garchomp core. Team lacked special Fairy answer and burn protection.
reflections.adjustment: Next game don't bring double physical into this opp. Bring Sinistcha early to Rage Powder block Will-O-Wisp for Kingambit, or drop Dragonite for special attacker. Prioritize Gengar-Mega Sludge Bomb to threaten Floette-Mega instead of Perish Song stall, and preserve Ice coverage for Garchomp without relying on Protect-bait.
